requirements.evidence: All contract items exist: Entity (app/Models/Entity.php:15-41), EntityMembership with scopes/casts (app/Models/EntityMembership.php:13-48), UserRole (app/Models/UserRole.php:5-19), both policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:9-39, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:9-33), factories, migrations with the named indexes (database/migrations/2026_08_01_000001_create_entity_memberships_table.php:19-26), pick (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:13-24) and the three components/views. Edge cases are handled: non-members get 403 even with a session elsewhere (tests/Feature/EntityTest.php:144), employees get 403 (tests/Feature/EntityTest.php:170), owner/last-manager removal is refused (tests/Feature/EntityTest.php:197), transfer rejects non-admins/self/foreign/vanished owner (tests/Feature/EntityTest.php:286, 298).

conventions.evidence: Most conventions are followed: policies for authorization, #[Fillable] (app/Models/Entity.php:14), enum/factories, Blade components + Bulma, migrations with reversible down(), docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated. Two clear deviations: every domain write is inline in the component/controller with no app/Actions/* class (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:35-112, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:39-121, app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:13-24), and public input properties have no #[Validate]/rules() (app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:26, app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:22-28), using inline $this->validate([...]) instead.

security.evidence: Every action re-resolves and authorizes the model before writing (Members.php:37,68,93; Settings.php:41,72,93); foreign membership IDs abort (Members.php:137-142); the entity is #[Locked] (Members.php:23-24, Settings.php:19-20); transfer validates the client-supplied target before casting (Settings.php:95); validation is server-side and Blade only uses {{ }} (resources/views/livewire/entity/members.blade.php:17-18). No mass-assignment or escaping weakness found.

tests.evidence: Broad Pest suite covers the DB single-owner invariant, policies, pick, page auth/verification, member add/assign/remove, settings save/delete/transfer, entity-lock tampering and transfer tampering (tests/Feature/EntityTest.php:26, 124, 170, 197, 230, 273, 286). Gap: no direct unauthorized-call test for Settings save()/delete()/transfer() beyond the owner-only mount assertion (tests/Feature/EntityTest.php:230).

simplicity.evidence: Lean and direct: reuses the UserRole enum, policy methods and factories; the owner/admin manager check is duplicated in both policies (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:36-39, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:30-33) and the same role list again in the component (Members.php:99-100).

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with descriptive names and short comments explaining non-obvious decisions, e.g. app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:110 (demote before promote because of the unique owner index) and app/Livewire/Entity/Members.php:137 (foreign membership check); consistent with sibling component/Blade style.

scope.evidence: Diff touches only task files: two migrations, models/enum/policies/factories, the three components and views, pick controller/route, lang/en+pt_BR, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md; no unrelated refactors or out-of-scope features.

issues.explanation: Entity pick, member add/assign/remove and settings save/delete/transfer write directly in the component/controller instead of one app/Actions/* class per use case with authorization inside, as the project conventions require.

Public input properties are validated only through inline $this->validate([...]) and have no #[Validate(...)] or rules() method, which violates Livewire policy rule 1 and the stated component pattern.
Only the owner-only mount is tested for Settings; there is no direct unauthorized-call test for save(), delete() or transfer() as a non-owner, which the Livewire test policy asks for per action.

The duplicate-member check is a read followed by an insert, so a concurrent duplicate reaches the unique index and surfaces as a QueryException (500) instead of the required validation error on email.
The owner/admin manager check is duplicated across both policies, and the same role list appears again in Members.php:99; a shared helper or scope would remove the repetition.

review.summary: Complete, secure implementation of the entities data model, policies, pick route and the dashboard/members/settings pages, backed by a thorough Pest suite and updated schema/CHANGELOG docs. It needs changes before merge on conventions: domain writes bypass the required app/Actions layer, Livewire input properties do not use #[Validate]/rules(), and Settings save/delete/transfer lack direct unauthorized-call tests.
